verdict.rationale: pnpm documents installing and pinning Node.js per project with no nvm or shell hooks. The runtime is declared in the checked-in package.json via `devEngines.runtime`, and pnpm fetches and bin-links it on install. pnpm also switches its own version from the `packageManager`/`devEngines.packageManager` field. Missing for 10: support for runtimes or tools beyond Node.js and pnpm itself, in-depth docs on version switching behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
